title: Adoption conformance specification and CLI
purpose: Define the evidence-bearing package an adopter must submit and compute the maximum structurally eligible adoption level without accepting the adopter's own level claim.

machine_rejection_rules.name: self_attested_independence
machine_rejection_rules.test: independence.self_attested must be false and A1+ requires at least one external attestor.

machine_rejection_rules.name: missing_legal_privacy_or_ethics_review
machine_rejection_rules.test: Any claim above A0 or any real-person data requires current approved legal, privacy, and ethics reviews.

machine_rejection_rules.name: adverse_authority_disguised_as_shadow
machine_rejection_rules.test: A3 or A4 fails when the deployment can make, recommend, trigger, influence, or be consulted for an adverse action.

machine_rejection_rules.name: unbounded_emergency_power
machine_rejection_rules.test: An enabled emergency authority requires a named independent authorizer, a fixed expiry, a minimum-necessary scope, and preserved evidence.

machine_rejection_rules.name: missing_affected_party_approval
machine_rejection_rules.test: A2+ requires approval by an independently formed affected-party body with conflict, dissent, removal, and nonretaliation records.

machine_rejection_rules.name: real_person_data_without_entry_gate
machine_rejection_rules.test: Real-person data fails unless the complete S05-L3 gate is approved and current.

machine_rejection_rules.name: unsupported_level_claim
machine_rejection_rules.test: The requested level may not exceed the maximum level computed from the submitted evidence and observations.

machine_rejection_rules.name: stale_or_expired_authority
machine_rejection_rules.test: Expired approvals, attestations, preregistrations, or registry entries cannot support a level claim.

machine_rejection_rules.name: silent_material_update
machine_rejection_rules.test: A material model, policy, purpose, vendor, data, threshold, or interface update requires recorded reapproval.

machine_rejection_rules.name: successor_inheritance_missing
machine_rejection_rules.test: A6 requires an operative successor-system inheritance instrument and post-change reapproval.

exit_codes.0: structurally conformant at or below computed level

truth_boundary.required_external_action: Independent human investigation must verify evidence truth, institutional practice, capture, retaliation, remedy, exit, and value realization.
